'''Alina Impeveri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] cult member, who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Alina was the daughter of [[Westa Impeveri]], a town counselor in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. She later became a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and joined the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
